text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now to introduce the<n>Umamusume in the
center! With<n>stellar performances in sprint, mile,<n>and
medium-distance races...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And countless G1 victories! Her<n>gallant running has
captivated<n>audiences everywhere—ladies and
gentlemen, I give you Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy! I'm here to make y'all<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After initially aiming to become<n>Umamusume of the
Year running only<n>sprint and mile races, Taiki Shuttle
has improved far beyond my<n>expectations...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No longer walled in by distance, she<n>embarks for
new horizons.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! We're finally back at the<n>academy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You said it! I'm just glad I could<n>make everyone
happy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that you, Suzuka? You restin'<n>up after the
race?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess so. But more than that, I<n>needed to
make sure it was there...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The place I'd like to see.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The place you'd like to see? You<n>mean...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The view from the lead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've never stopped running for it, and<n>yet I still
haven't reached it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm always looking at your back<n>instead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One excels in mile races. The other<n>excels in
medium-distance.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Taiki Shuttle has shown<n>tremendous growth
and successfully<n>emerged victorious into
medium-distance territory.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Are you happy, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm real happy I got to go<n>head-to-head with ya,
Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I love spendin' time with<n>my friends 'n'
family. That makes<n>me plenty happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But it ain't the same. This is<n>happiness that gets
my heart<n>pumpin' hot.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a happiness I can't get nowhere<n>else... Do you
feel it too, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I've come to realize<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view from up front, where I'm<n>truly alone...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not a place I can reach on<n>my own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You keep running ahead of me... and<n>that makes me
want to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No... I will surpass you. I'll show youthat I can.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's why... I think this situation is<n>okay for me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, in that case, it's okay for<n>me too! I just
wanna take ya on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know just how strong ya are,<n>Suzuka—stronger
than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's keep this happiness pipin' hot!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll promise you this. I won't give up<n>on taking the
lead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two have forged a bond, having<n>grown closer
over their countless<n>battles. I don't want to miss a
single<n>moment from here.
